description: Record/replay script for the LJCMG Accela CapHome enforcement search (LJCMGClient.cs:75-175). Drives FakeBrowserBackend deterministically with no Chromium and no live traffic. Phase 1 uses only 'states'/'transitions'; the shape is intentionally open for Phase 2 to add per-transition 'delayMs'/'fail' and per-state 'inject' (timeout/pageCrashed) blocks without restructuring.
